That ghost story reminded me of the importance of standing up to fear and facing challenges head-on. This is particularly relevant today, as we confront the rising threat of a new type of extremism and terrorism. Enemies have carried out attacks in places like New York, Washington D.C., Bali, London, Madrid, Moscow, and many other locations. Despite these clear dangers, some people seem to have forgotten the lessons of history. With the growing lethality and availability of weapons, can we truly afford to believe that vicious extremists can be appeased? Can people really think that free societies can negotiate with those who seek to destroy them?
